name: Gauntlet Race Reference Fidelity Gate
hardFailures: any missing or substituted race-defining feature
generic humanoid silhouette where reference is distinctive
primitive/capsule/cylinder/egg construction visible at gameplay camera distance
face or head construction materially different from reference
armor, clothing, crown, mantle, shell, rune, fungal, sensory, or timeline forms materially redesigned
front/side/back forms inconsistent with the locked turnaround
incorrect race height or major landmark proportions beyond 3 percent of character height
palette or material-zone drift that changes character identity
floating, detached, intersecting, or implausibly attached signature geometry
skin collapse, candy-wrapper twist, weight popping, or armor rubberization during required animation poses
technical pass presented as visual acceptance without reference comparison evidence
procedural placeholder source presented as production-authored replacement
releaseRule: Every race must individually pass every hard failure check, every category minimum, overall >= 97, all four views, technical validation, and locked-reference provenance. One failed race rejects the entire five-race release.
